title: MMPP promotes adipogenesis and glucose uptake via binding to the PPARgamma ligand binding domain in 3T3-L1 MBX cells.
authors: Kim, Na-Yeon; Lim, Chae-Min; Park, Hyo-Min; Kim, Jinju; Pham, Thu-Huyen; Yang, Young; Lee, Hee Pom; Hong, Jin Tae; Yoon, Do-Young
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小分子MMPP与转录因子PPARgamma配体结合域的分子对接及促脂肪生成作用，虽涉及TF-DNA相关转录因子但核心是配体-蛋白互作而非TF-DNA结合，方法仅含分子对接，属广义蛋白-配体互作，对TF-DNA课题借鉴有限。
abstract: Peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor-gamma (PPARgamma) is a transcription factor involved in adipogenesis, and its transcriptional activity depends on its ligands. Thiazolidinediones (TZDs), well-known PPARgamma agonists, are drugs that improve insulin resistance in type 2 diabetes. However, TZDs are associated with severe adverse effects. As current therapies are not well designed, novel PPARgamma agonists have been investigated in adipocytes. (E)-2-methoxy-4-(3-(4-methoxyphenyl) prop-1-en-1-yl) phenol (MMPP) is known to have anti-arthritic, anti-inflammatory, and anti-cancer effects. In this study, we demonstrated the adipogenic effects of MMPP on the regulation of PPARgamma transcriptional activity during adipocyte differentiation in vitro. MMPP treatment increased PPARgamma transcriptional activity, and molecular docking studies revealed that MMPP binds directly to the PPARgamma ligand binding domain. MMPP and rosiglitazone showed similar binding affinities to the PPARgamma. MMPP significantly promoted lipid accumulation in adipocyte cells and increased the expression of C/EBPbeta and the levels of p-AKT, p-GSK3, and p-AMPKalpha at an early stage. MMPP enhanced the expression of adipogenic markers such as PPARgamma, C/EBPalpha, FAS, ACC, GLUT4, FABP4 and adiponectin in the late stage. MMPP also improved insulin sensitivity by increasing glucose uptake. Thus, MMPP, as a PPARgamma agonist, may be a potential drug for type 2 diabetes and metabolic disorders, which may help increase adipogenesis and insulin sensitivity.
abstract_zh: 过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体-γ（PPARgamma）是一种参与脂肪生成的转录因子，其转录活性依赖于其配体。噻唑烷二酮类（TZDs）是众所周知的PPARgamma激动剂，是改善2型糖尿病胰岛素抵抗的药物。然而，TZDs伴随严重的不良反应。由于现有疗法设计不佳，已在脂肪细胞中研究了新型PPARgamma激动剂。(E)-2-甲氧基-4-(3-(4-甲氧基苯基)丙-1-烯-1-基)苯酚（MMPP）已知具有抗关节炎、抗炎和抗癌作用。在本研究中，我们证明了MMPP在体外脂肪细胞分化过程中对PPARgamma转录活性调控的促脂肪生成作用。MMPP处理增加了PPARgamma转录活性，分子对接研究显示MMPP直接结合于PPARgamma配体结合域。MMPP和罗格列酮对PPARgamma表现出相似的结合亲和力。MMPP显著促进脂肪细胞中的脂质积累，并在早期阶段增加C/EBPbeta的表达以及p-AKT、p-GSK3和p-AMPKalpha的水平。MMPP在晚期阶段增强了脂肪生成标志物如PPARgamma、C/EBPalpha、FAS、ACC、GLUT4、FABP4和脂联素的表达。MMPP还通过增加葡萄糖摄取来改善胰岛素敏感性。因此，MMPP作为PPARgamma激动剂，可能是治疗2型糖尿病和代谢紊乱的潜在药物，有助于增加脂肪生成和胰岛素敏感性。
